dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple pale 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible, characterized by irregular, feathered high-contrast perimeters. The transition from the dark exterior to the lighter interior is gradual and diffuse rather than sharp-edged. Prominent structures include a large nearly-closed loop on the mid-lateral flank and a cluster of interlocking elliptical rings on the posterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, isolated high-intensity silvery-white punctate spots concentrated along the lower-lateral margin. These lack internal gradients and measure approximately 2-10 pixels in diameter. Low density of larger, amorphous high-intensity clusters distributed along the mid-dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary scalene triangle is formed by connecting the centroids of the large 'O' ring on the lower flank, the prominent 'C' structure directly superior to it, and the largest ring in the posterior cluster. A series of nearly linear spatial relationships exists among the high-intensity blobs along the ventral-lateral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A human hand and forearm, partially obscured by a black sleeve, are visible grasping the seal's left pelvic flipper in the lower-left quadrant of the frame.
